verify.note: Measures the CONSEQUENCE, not the literal that happened to satisfy it. Widened 2026-09-25 with LIVE-507: this probe used to require the exact string widthClass="w-auto sm:w-full", so fixing the shaped-path collapse (which had to replace w-auto with a DEFINITE width) failed a row that had not regressed -- the same shape of stale assertion LIVE-082 carried. What LIVE-145 is actually about is that the full bleed reaches BOTH edges: the component exposes widthClass and bakes no w-full into its base string (nothing collides), the event page delivers its width through that prop with no w-* left in className, there is EXACTLY ONE base width class, and that width is not plain w-full -- which with -mx-4 shifts the box instead of widening it and leaves the 34px stripe. Any definite bleeding width passes; re-baking w-full, moving the width back into className, adding a second base width, or reverting to plain w-full all fail. components/media/poster-band.test.tsx is the enforcing arm.
